title: A Salt for the Wolf
author: Rosalind Whitlock
blurb: Sable Zhou, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
